used.item: Weak Points and Strong — avoid what is strong, strike at what is weak
used.hook: 27-year shop, sales halved after a superstore opened
6 months, 0 open conversations; public true praise at a dawat

used.item: Wealth Is What You Don't See
used.hook: gets off 200 m before the school gate
came home and spoke to no one

used.item: WYSIATI — What You See Is All There Is
used.hook: comes home at 3 am every night
14-year tea stall down to 40 cups a day after a new café; free first cup on winter dawns
salary doubled, month-end balance zero; wife's 'ঝড়ের দিন' passbook saves the family after layoff

used.item: All are equal, but some become more equal
used.hook: secretary promised 'everyone equal'; a year later the generator runs only on his floor; old signed rules pinned on the notice board
12 years of 'তোর জন্যই তো'; brother leaves an open-university admission form
11 customers a day, 11 bargains, almost zero profit; an honest value card on the counter

used.item: Know yourself and know your opponent
used.hook: 200 sums every night, still 38 in the test exam; three old answer scripts

used.item: The Law of Envy — Beware the Fragile Ego
used.hook: 80 orders vs 12; admits envy at 4:30 am and learns the hidden cost
3 parcels in a month from Facebook lives; 'only 2 left' every night for 7 nights
3 years of 500 tk a month in an envelope marked 'for nothing'

used.item: Submit to Reality: The Ideal Apprenticeship
